pleasurehorizons:identity.description: Her name and spawn egg colours.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the game shows for her.

fields.name: egg_primary
fields.description: Base colour of her spawn egg.

fields.name: egg_secondary
fields.description: Spot colour of her spawn egg.

pleasurehorizons:body.description: Her model lineage, hitbox, held item, lighting and bed needs.

fields.name: body_type
fields.description: The base model her animations are authored against. Decides which scenes fit her.

fields.name: hitbox_height
fields.description: Her height in blocks.

fields.name: held_item_offset
fields.description: Moves the item in her hand as [x, y, z] in model pixels, added to where the game holds it.

fields.name: held_item_rotation
fields.description: Turns the item in her hand as [x, y, z] in degrees, added to the way the game holds it.

fields.name: held_item_scale
fields.description: How large the item in her hand is drawn, as a multiple of the usual size. 1 is the usual size.

fields.name: shading
fields.description: How she is shaded: soft, vanilla (the game's own lights), toon (flat tones with a clean edge) or flat (no side darker than another, for a model with its shading painted in). default uses the player's own setting.

fields.name: only_uses_double_beds
fields.description: Whether she refuses a single bed.

fields.name: wears_clothes
fields.description: Whether she has clothes to take off and put on. Set false for a girl who is always nude (the Kobold): she is never dressed or undressed, scenes that start by undressing her just start, and she needs only a nude model.

pleasurehorizons:stats.description: Health, speed, attack damage and belly size.

fields.name: health
fields.description: Maximum health.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Movement speed. 0.2 is a walking player.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Attack damage.

fields.name: max_belly_inflation_size
fields.description: How large her belly can grow.

fields.name: sprint_speed
fields.description: Movement speed while she sprints. 0 means the same as when she walks.

pleasurehorizons:taste.description: What draws her in: the item that tames her.

fields.name: tame_item
fields.description: The item that tames her. Each girl needs a different one.

pleasurehorizons:personality.description: Her archetype, which biases her rolled tastes.

fields.name: personality
fields.description: Her archetype. It biases how her likes and dislikes are rolled once.

pleasurehorizons:dialogue.description: The lines she answers gifts with.

fields.name: gift_like
fields.description: Lines for a liked gift at a low relationship. One is picked at random.

fields.name: gift_love
fields.description: Lines for a liked gift at a high relationship. One is picked at random.

pleasurehorizons:ai.description: How she behaves: her traits, one for each category.

fields.name: traits
fields.description: How she behaves, as one trait for each category: { "movement": "flier", "temperament": { "type": "skittish", "distance": 10 } }. A category she leaves out gives her its default trait.

fields.name: preset
fields.description: The brain preset her traits start from. Leave it out for the standard one. A wild girl with no brain has none.

pleasurehorizons:spawn.description: Where and when a wild girl turns up in the world by herself. With a weight of 0 she never does.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: How likely she is to be chosen against the other wild girls who fit the place. 0 means she never spawns by herself.

fields.name: biomes
fields.description: The biomes she lives in, as ids (minecraft:swamp) or tags (#minecraft:is_forest). Empty means any biome.

fields.name: group_min
fields.description: The fewest who arrive together.

fields.name: group_max
fields.description: The most who arrive together.

fields.name: max_nearby
fields.description: How many of her may be around before no more are spawned. Counted in a wide area; tamed girls are not counted.

fields.name: time
fields.description: When she appears.

fields.name: min_y
fields.description: The lowest height she spawns at.

fields.name: max_y
fields.description: The highest height she spawns at.

pleasurehorizons:merchant.description: How a travelling merchant visits, stands about and undresses as she gets to know a player.

fields.name: visit_weight
fields.description: How likely she is to be the merchant who calls, against the other merchants. 0 means she never visits by herself.

fields.name: wander_speed
fields.description: How fast she wanders about while she waits, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: look_range
fields.description: How close a player must be for her to look at them.

fields.name: shirt_at
fields.description: The affection at which her cloak comes off.

fields.name: underwear_at
fields.description: The affection at which the outfit under her cloak comes off.

fields.name: bare_at
fields.description: The affection at which nothing is left.

fields.name: cloak_bones
fields.description: The outermost layer of her model, hidden once she is comfortable. Only the outermost bone of each piece is needed.

fields.name: shirt_bones
fields.description: The outfit under the cloak, hidden at the next stage. Only the outermost bone of each piece is needed.

fields.name: skirt_back_bones
fields.description: The back of the skirt: hidden under the cloak, shown once the cloak is off, and gone again with the shirt. Only the outermost bone of each piece is needed.

fields.name: bare_bones
fields.description: The bare legs: hidden while the cloak or the shirt covers them, shown once neither does. Only the outermost bone of each piece is needed.

pleasurehorizons:chest.description: Lets her carry a chest that a player can fill. Leave it out for a girl who cannot.

fields.name: bone
fields.description: The model bone that shows the chest while she carries it.

fields.name: clip_prefix
fields.description: What goes in front of an everyday clip's name (idle, walk, run, fly) while she carries the chest, when her animation file has that clip.

fields.name: hides_held_item
fields.description: Whether the item in her hand is hidden while she carries the chest.

pleasurehorizons:display.description: How she is drawn day to day: her standing clip, whether she shows a held item, and a part her owner can hide.

fields.name: idle_clip
fields.description: The clip she plays when she stands still on the ground.

fields.name: shows_held_item
fields.description: Whether the item in her hand is drawn on her.

fields.name: hideable_part
fields.description: A model bone her owner can hide or show with the girl staff. Empty for none.

fields.name: hideable_label
fields.description: What the staff button calls that part: it reads Disable Part or Enable Part.

fields.name: render_mode
fields.description: How her body is drawn. translucent is the usual. cutout is for a rig of stacked planes (a head with hair and horns) that shows through itself translucent; use translucent_bones for a soft patch on it.

fields.name: translucent_bones
fields.description: Bones drawn blended even when her body is cutout, for a soft painted patch such as a blush.

fields.name: leash_offset
fields.description: Added to where a leash meets her: [x sideways, y up, z forward].

pleasurehorizons:look.description: What can differ from girl to girl of this kind: picks, colours, sliders and switches, each working on bones of her model, with random values for a new girl and a customise screen.

fields.name: options
fields.description: What can differ from girl to girl. Each is { "type": "choice" | "colours" | "slider" | "flag", "id": "...", ... }: a choice has variants (a label and the bones it shows), colours have slots (the bones each tints) and presets, a slider has min, max, default and effects (bone_scale, bone_offset, max_health, body_scale), a flag has the bones it shows.

fields.name: plain_bones
fields.description: Bones kept white, so their own painted colours show.

fields.name: scene_bones
fields.description: Bones shown only while a scene is running.

pleasurehorizons:encounter.description: Lets a clan send her to raid a settlement, and lets her be taken captive, held in a Stockade and sign on. Needs the kobold brain preset to act.

fields.name: min_recruit_trust
fields.description: The trust a captive must have before she can sign on to the settlement.

fields.name: max_recruit_fear
fields.description: The most fear a captive can have and still sign on.

fields.name: required_custody_days
fields.description: How many days she must be held in a secured Stockade (tied to a post, with a guard) before she can sign on.

pleasurehorizons:worker.description: Lets a wild girl join a settlement and work there. Leave it out for a girl who cannot.

fields.name: jobs
fields.description: The jobs she may be given in a settlement, by name. Only mineworker can be done by a girl who is not a settler.

movement.description: How she gets around: ground, flying or flying_walks_indoors.

accepts_collar.description: Whether a player can put a collar on her.

can_be_tamed.description: Whether the Girl Staff can tame her.

takes_gifts.description: Whether gifts raise her affection and right-click opens her scene menu.

loadout.description: The loot table her weapons and armour are drawn from when she is first spawned, such as mypack:loadouts/bandit. Empty for none.

movement.description: How she gets around: on foot, flying or swimming.

temperament.description: How she meets strangers and trouble: hostile, skittish, docile or only defending herself.

loadout.description: What she spawns with: weapons and armour, drawn from a loot table.

interaction.description: What a player can do with her: tame her, give her gifts, put a collar on her, tell her to sit or follow, talk to her.

routine.description: How her day goes: when she sleeps and what she does while she is idle.

territory.description: Where she stays: anywhere, or near a home or settlement.

work.description: Whether a settler does the work of her settlement.

pleasurehorizons:affectionate.description: Gifts of the item she likes raise her affection, and right-clicking her opens her scene menu. A girl without this trait has no gifts and no menu for strangers.

pleasurehorizons:aloof.description: A settler keeps to herself: she does not ask anyone to bed. She still talks and follows her contract holder.

pleasurehorizons:archer.description: She shoots with a bow when she holds one and fights up close when she has none. She needs a bow from her loadout, such as archer_kit.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she moves while she fights, as a multiple of her speed.

params.name: min_range
params.description: How close a target gets before she backs away when she is hurt.

params.name: max_range
params.description: How far a target gets before she closes in when she is hurt.

params.name: cooldown_ticks
params.description: The pause between shots, in ticks.

pleasurehorizons:archer_kit.description: She spawns with a stone sword and a bow, from the loot table pleasurehorizons:loadouts/archer_kit.

pleasurehorizons:bee_flier.description: The bee girl's way of moving: she flies in the open, and where a roof is close above (a house, a cave) she lands and walks instead. Her animation file needs the flying clips and the walking ones.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she flies, as a multiple of her speed.

params.name: radius
params.description: How far from where she started she drifts.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she closes in on her target, as a multiple of her speed.

pleasurehorizons:collar.description: A player can put a collar on her, dye it and take it off with shears.

pleasurehorizons:curious.description: She turns to watch a player who comes near, and follows one who holds out the item she likes, though she is nobody's.

params.name: look_range
params.description: How close a player must be for her to look at them.

params.name: follow_speed
params.description: How fast she follows a player holding her item, as a multiple of her speed.

pleasurehorizons:defensive.description: She leaves players alone and fights back against whoever hurts her.

params.name: spares_girls
params.description: Whether she leaves other girls alone when they hurt her.

pleasurehorizons:diurnal.description: A settler works by day and rests at night, as the settlement expects.

pleasurehorizons:docile.description: She never fights: she does not attack and does not fight back.

pleasurehorizons:flier.description: She flies: she drifts about, hovers, follows her owner through the air and never takes fall damage. Her animation file needs fly and float_idle clips.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she flies, as a multiple of her speed.

params.name: radius
params.description: How far from where she started she drifts.

pleasurehorizons:homebody.description: She keeps near the bed she has claimed and flies back to it when she strays, and is drawn to chests. For a girl who flies.

params.name: radius
params.description: How far from home she goes.

pleasurehorizons:hostile.description: She attacks players she sees and chases them, and fights back against whoever hurts her. She spares her owner and, once tamed, every player. A player who holds out the item she likes, or whom she is fond enough of, is spared too, which is how a hostile girl is won over.

params.name: calmed_by_item
params.description: Whether she leaves alone a player who holds out the item she likes.

params.name: fond_percent
params.description: She leaves alone a player once her affection is at least this percent of the most it can be. 0 means affection never spares anyone.

pleasurehorizons:idler.description: A settler does no work: she is in the settlement but never takes a job.

pleasurehorizons:insomniac.description: She never sleeps: she is awake day and night, looking about and at players who come near.

params.name: look_range
params.description: How close a player must be for her to look at them.

pleasurehorizons:long_shift.description: A settler works through the day and well into the evening, and rests later than the settlement does.

params.name: work_starts
params.description: The tick of the day she starts work (0 is dawn).

params.name: rest_starts
params.description: The tick of the day she goes to bed (12000 is dusk).

pleasurehorizons:loot.description: She spawns with whatever a loot table of your own gives her. Name it in the table setting: armour goes to its slot, the first other item in her main hand and the second in her off hand.

params.name: table
params.description: The loot table, such as mypack:loadouts/bandit. Empty means nothing.

pleasurehorizons:nocturnal.description: A settler works by night and rests by day.

params.name: work_starts
params.description: The tick of the day she starts work (12000 is dusk).

params.name: rest_starts
params.description: The tick of the day she goes to bed (0 is dawn).

pleasurehorizons:raider.description: She spawns with a stone or iron sword, a bow and some armour of mixed kinds, drawn from the loot table pleasurehorizons:loadouts/raider.

pleasurehorizons:resident.description: A settler stays near her settlement and comes back when she strays.

params.name: slack
params.description: How far past the edge she may wander before she turns back.

params.name: walk_speed
params.description: How fast she walks back.

params.name: arrival_range
params.description: How close to the settlement she gets before she stops.

pleasurehorizons:skittish.description: She is shy: she runs from a player who comes close, unless they sneak up on her slowly or hold out the item she likes. A tamed girl does not run.

params.name: distance
params.description: How close a player gets before she runs.

params.name: sneak_distance
params.description: How close a player who is sneaking gets before she notices them.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she runs, as a multiple of her speed.

params.name: calmed_by_item
params.description: Whether a player holding out the item she likes does not scare her.

pleasurehorizons:sleeper.description: She sleeps in a bed when it is time, and looks about and at players while she is free.

params.name: look_range
params.description: How close a player must be for her to look at them.

pleasurehorizons:social.description: A settler talks to the player, can be asked to bed and follows the one she is contracted to.

pleasurehorizons:stationary.description: She stays where she is: she swims up out of water, opens doors and runs from fire, but never wanders off. For a shopkeeper, a guard or anyone who has a post.

params.name: fall_damage
params.description: Whether a fall hurts her.

pleasurehorizons:tameable.description: The Girl Staff can tame her once her affection is full. Tamed, she follows her owner, sits when told and fights for them. Without this trait the staff refuses her.

params.name: tempt_speed
params.description: How fast she follows a player holding what she likes.

params.name: follow_start
params.description: How far from her owner she is before she starts to follow.

params.name: follow_stop
params.description: How close to her owner she gets before she stops.

pleasurehorizons:walker.description: She gets around on foot: swims when she is in water, opens doors, runs from fire and wanders about.

params.name: speed
params.description: How fast she wanders, as a multiple of her speed.

params.name: fall_damage
params.description: Whether a fall hurts her.

pleasurehorizons:worker.description: A settler does the work of her settlement, whatever her job is.

pleasurehorizons:float_to_surface.description: Swims up when she is in water or lava.

pleasurehorizons:panic_on_fire.description: Runs when she is on fire or stuck in powder snow.

pleasurehorizons:hold_conversation.description: Stands still and listens while a player talks to her.

pleasurehorizons:wait_for_delivery.description: Waits for a hauler to hand her what she asked for.

pleasurehorizons:guard_stockade.description: Keeps watch inside a stockade when she is a guard assigned to one.

pleasurehorizons:follow_to_bed.description: Goes to a bed she has agreed to go to with the player.

pleasurehorizons:look_at_target.description: Turns her head towards what she is looking at.

pleasurehorizons:move_to_walk_target.description: Walks to where she has decided to go.

pleasurehorizons:interact_with_door.description: Opens a door that is on her path.

pleasurehorizons:target_or_retaliate.description: Picks a target to fight back against when she is hurt.

pleasurehorizons:set_player_look_target.description: Looks at a player who is close.

pleasurehorizons:stay_near_settlement.description: Walks her back inside her settlement's border once she has strayed outside it.

fields.name: slack
fields.description: How far outside the settlement's border she may be before she is steered back.

fields.name: walk_speed
fields.description: How fast she walks back.

fields.name: arrival_range
fields.description: How close to the centre she gets before she lets go.

pleasurehorizons:set_random_walk_target.description: Picks a place nearby to wander to. Settings: radius (blocks), speed.

fields.name: min_ticks
fields.description: The shortest she stands still, in ticks.

fields.name: max_ticks
fields.description: The longest she stands still, in ticks.

pleasurehorizons:leave_settlement.description: A traveller whose visit is over walks out of the area to despawn.

pleasurehorizons:eat_from_storage.description: Walks to a storage building and eats.

pleasurehorizons:deliver_supplies.description: Carries supplies to a settler who is waiting for them.

pleasurehorizons:tend_farm_plots.description: Tends the farm plots of a farmer's job.

pleasurehorizons:work_the_mine.description: Works the mine, for a miner.

pleasurehorizons:collect_supplies.description: Fetches her own supplies when her work has stopped for want of something.

pleasurehorizons:forge_orders.description: Works through forge orders at her station.

pleasurehorizons:work_at_station.description: Does her job at her workstation.

pleasurehorizons:return_supplies.description: Puts spare inputs back in storage.

pleasurehorizons:go_to_bed_and_sleep.description: Walks to her claimed bed and sleeps.

pleasurehorizons:propose_intimacy.description: Crosses the settlement to ask a player of her own accord.

pleasurehorizons:follow_contract_holder.description: Follows the player who holds her contract.

pleasurehorizons:kobold_settlement_commu.description: Travels between her camp and the settlement she raids or has joined.
pleasurehorizons:kobold_settlement_commu.for: a girl with the encounter component

pleasurehorizons:escort_encounter_captiv.description: Leads a captive girl she has taken.
pleasurehorizons:escort_encounter_captiv.for: a girl with the encounter component

pleasurehorizons:raid_settlement_storage.for: a girl with the encounter component

pleasurehorizons:invalidate_attack_targe.description: Drops a target that is gone or no longer valid.

pleasurehorizons:animatable_melee_attack.description: Swings at her target with the attack animation.

fields.name: delay_ticks
fields.description: Ticks of wind up before the swing lands.

pleasurehorizons:nearby_living_entities.description: Notices players, iron golems, wolves and baby turtles nearby.

pleasurehorizons:nearby_raid_targets.description: Notices what a kobold attacks in a raid.
pleasurehorizons:nearby_raid_targets.for: a girl with the encounter component

pleasurehorizons:swim.description: Swims up when she is in water.

pleasurehorizons:sit.description: Sits when she has been told to.

pleasurehorizons:long_door_interact.description: Opens and closes doors on her way.

pleasurehorizons:tempt.description: Follows a player holding an item she likes: her favourite one, or the one named in "item".

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she follows.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item she follows. Leave it out for her favourite one.

pleasurehorizons:revenge.description: Fights back against whoever hurt her.

fields.name: spares_girls
fields.description: Whether she leaves other girls alone when they hurt her.

pleasurehorizons:fly_follow_owner.description: Flies after her owner and stays close. Only for a girl who flies.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she flies for this goal.

fields.name: start_distance
fields.description: How far from her owner she is before she follows.

fields.name: stop_distance
fields.description: How close to her owner she gets.

pleasurehorizons:fly_return_home.description: Flies back to her claimed bed when she has strayed too far. Only for a girl who flies.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she flies for this goal.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: How far from her home she goes.

pleasurehorizons:fly_wander.description: Drifts about near her claimed bed, hovering now and then. Only for a girl who flies.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she flies for this goal.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: How far from her home she goes.

pleasurehorizons:sleep_in_bed.description: Goes to a bed and sleeps when it is time.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves for this goal, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves for this goal, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves for this goal, as a multiple of her speed.

pleasurehorizons:escape_danger.description: Runs from fire and the like.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves for this goal, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves for this goal, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: start_distance
fields.description: How far from her owner she is before she starts to follow.

fields.name: stop_distance
fields.description: How close to her owner she gets before she stops.

pleasurehorizons:look_at_player.description: Looks at a player who is close.

fields.name: range
fields.description: How close a player must be for her to look at them.

pleasurehorizons:bow_attack.description: Shoots her target with a bow when she is holding one, and keeps her distance when she is hurt.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she moves while she shoots, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: min_range
fields.description: How close a target gets before she backs away (when she is hurt or has no weapon).

fields.name: max_range
fields.description: How far a target gets before she closes in (when she is hurt or has no weapon).

fields.name: cooldown_ticks
fields.description: The pause between shots, in ticks.

pleasurehorizons:flee_players.description: Runs from a player who comes close, unless they are sneaking up on her or holding out the item she likes. Put "when": "untamed" on it to leave her owner alone.

fields.name: distance
fields.description: How close a player gets before she runs.

fields.name: sneak_distance
fields.description: How close a player who is sneaking gets before she notices them. A player sneaking up slowly can get this close.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast she runs, as a multiple of her speed.

fields.name: calmed_by_item
fields.description: Whether a player holding out the item she likes does not scare her.

pleasurehorizons:target_players.description: Picks a player as her target, except her owner, one holding out the item she likes and one she is fond of enough. Put "when": "untamed" on it to leave every player alone once she is tamed.

fields.name: spare_when_holding_item
fields.description: Whether she leaves alone a player who holds out the item she likes.

fields.name: spare_fond_percent
fields.description: She leaves alone a player once her affection is at least this percent of the most it can be. 0 means affection never spares anyone.

brain_conditions.pleasurehorizons:kobold_unrestrained: She is awake and not held by a capture order.
brain_conditions.pleasurehorizons:kobold_roaming: She is awake and free, and if she belongs to a settlement it is day.

goal_conditions.pleasurehorizons:following_and_tamed: She is tamed and has been told to follow.
goal_conditions.pleasurehorizons:following_tamed_and_awa: She is tamed, has been told to follow, and is awake.
goal_conditions.pleasurehorizons:free_and_awake: She is awake and nothing is holding her still.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: The scene's name, as a language key such as scene.pleasurehorizons.missionary.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Where and how the scene is played.

fields.name: requires_affection
fields.description: The affection a girl needs before she agrees.

fields.name: cum_threshold
fields.description: How far along the scene must be before it can end.

fields.name: needs_to_strip
fields.description: Whether the girl is undressed first.

fields.name: counts_towards_impregnation
fields.description: Whether the scene can lead to a pregnancy.

fields.name: hide_player
fields.description: Whether the player's body is hidden.

fields.name: use_keyframe_events
fields.description: Whether the clips' markers play chat lines and sounds.

fields.name: replace_default_animations
fields.description: Whether her own scene file replaces the shared one.

fields.name: bed_alignment_offset
fields.description: How far she is moved along the bed.

fields.name: amount_of_loops
fields.description: How many loops the scene plays.

fields.name: minigame
fields.description: The pace game for this scene: "classic" keeps the old hold-the-key bar, or a block of numbers that replaces the feel read from the clips (slow_band, fast_band as [low, high], slow_seconds, fast_seconds, blend_seconds, fill_seconds).

fields.name: body_types
fields.description: The body types the animation fits. Empty means every body.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: What the scene appeals to.

fields.name: supported_girls
fields.description: Only these girls get the scene. Not with unsupported_girls.

fields.name: unsupported_girls
fields.description: Every girl but these gets the scene. Not with supported_girls.

fields.name: girl_overrides
fields.description: Per girl settings that replace the scene's own, by girl id.

cues.description: Every cue name (one dash-separated part of a marker) that the game's own animations fire. A binding for a cue that is in no animation never plays.
